text_block_list.text:
I rush Маяно Топ Ган to the infirmary
after she
hurts herself в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, owwww! This injury's gonna keep
me
grounded for a while...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll be in even better shape than
before
with you around to nurse me. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Eeeee! ☆ Yay!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Okay! First thing's first, you have to take
my
temperature...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list:
Take your temperature? You're injured, not
sick.

text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff! My heart's
gonna beat
so hard that it zooms right
outta my chest—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Urk!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: H-huh?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: That... really hurt, I think...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! No way! This is how grown-ups
show
affection!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Weird... The book said that this method
would be
a total killer... ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Maybe it's because I don't have a
fever!
Maybe if I give myself one, it'll
work out just
like—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Mmgrgh... Fiiine.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Don't tell me you're not the type to
swoon over
something like this.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Well then, what do you like, Тренер?
What can I
do to make your heart skip a
beat?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
My health? So you're saying that me
being
healthy makes you happy?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: What?! Really?! Are you serious?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Then I'll rest a ton and get right
back on
my feet!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! We can train
together
again. ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган gets a bit carried away
with her
roleplay. I look after her until
she's back to
normal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just as she promised, Маяно Топ Ган
gets some
proper rest and resumes her
training in good
health.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган seems a bit
disheartened, but
she manages to get
enough rest...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
